{{Top|leg}}
The '''Imperial Cavalcade of Stars''' was a [[Holotheater/Legends|holotheater]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]]. The premiere of [[Quintana Trill]]'s new [[Holodrama/Legends|holofilm]], ''[[Denizens of Dakaret IX]]'', was held there.<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref>
